fields.subject: SimpleDbConnection
fields.trigger: a caller requests the retry delay for an attempt number
fields.response: return a Retry backoff TimeSpan using the configured interval and lengthening selection: HalfSquare uses (attempt × attempt ÷ 2), Linear uses attempt, Squaring uses 2^(attempt − 1), and every other selection uses (attempt + attempt − 1); when the corresponding settings are absent, use 250 milliseconds and the default selection.
fields.postcondition: the returned duration is determined without modifying the SimpleDbConnection settings.
